title: Lists: Group Content Items in a Container | Orchard Core
description:
Some content belongs together: the posts of a blog, the pages of a help center. Without a container, each item stands alone, and nothing says which items go together.

The Lists module adds the List part. A content type that has it becomes a list: a content item that holds other content items, with its own admin page to create and find them, and a page on the site that shows the published ones.

In this video:
• What a list is
• The Blog as a list in the admin
• Creating a list type with the List part
• Creating a list and adding items to it
• Finding items by status and by title
• Seeing the list on the site
